critical_governance: Only approved model and localization revisions may be issued as authoritative machine-control jobs.
Machine-control job files retain CRS/datum/geoid/units, checksum, lineage and source handoff evidence from Phase 16.
Automatic grade/control enablement requires compatible equipment, healthy positioning, authorized operator and configured safety prerequisites.
AI cannot enable autonomous machine control, override geofences/no-go zones, certify localization/model accuracy, or publish safety-critical revisions.
Design changes require impact review, withdrawal/reissue controls and operator acknowledgement.
As-built and production data are traceable to exact job/model/localization/device/operator session.
